loginHint: Sign in with your own post. account. Connect email, calendars and clouds afterwards in settings.
passwordHint: Separate post. password · at least 12 characters
setupHint: Find the one-time code on your server in DATA_DIR/admin-setup-token.
pending: Registration saved. An administrator must approve your account before you can sign in.
passwordLength: The password must be 12 to 256 characters long.
registrationFailed: This account cannot be registered. Please contact the administrator.
loginFailed: Sign-in failed. Check your credentials and whether your account has been approved.
forbidden: You do not have permission for this action.
noMail: Connect a mailbox in Settings → Account & connections first.
rate: Too many attempts. Please wait ten minutes.
lastAdmin: The last active administrator cannot be disabled or demoted.
separatePassword: Your post. password is separate from your email account password.
mailOptional: post. also works without a connected mailbox.
migrationHint: Existing installation? Connect your previous mailbox before creating new data. After verification, existing contacts, calendars and files will be assigned to you.
disconnectConfirm: Disconnect mailbox? Your private files, contacts and calendars are preserved. Local email drafts will be removed.
mailOwned: This mailbox is already assigned to another post. user.
migrationNotEmpty: Your new account must still be empty for this migration. Contact the administrator so no data is overwritten.
reconnect: The mailbox must be authorized again.
oauthState: Authorization is invalid or expired. Please restart it.
oauthFailed: The mailbox was not connected. Check the email address, OAuth configuration and provider IMAP access.
passwordChanged: Password changed. Other sessions have been signed out.
adminHint: Manage users, groups and access to mail, calendars and files. Administrators have no automatic read access to private data. User changes sign out their sessions.
deleteGroupConfirm: Delete group? Its file grants and memberships will also be removed.
welcomeHint: Connect a mailbox or start using your contacts, calendars and files.
sharingHint: Shares apply to this item and its descendants. User and group rights are combined. Remove all applicable grants to revoke access. Only the owner manages sharing.
deleteUserConfirm: Permanently delete user “{{name}}” and all their local data? Files at Google / Microsoft and provider emails are not deleted. This user’s shares will be removed.
sharedEmptyHint: Files and folders shared with you or your groups will appear here.
